description: French Food Outlets Locations publishes a national inventory assembled from French institutional sources for food-environment research. Quentin Creurer at INRAE provides CSV snapshots identified as April 2025, including a food-commerce file dated 4 April, food-safety records, organic-operator records and trade-bulletin records. The linked processing notebook joins SIRENE, Alim’ Confiance, organic-operator and BODACC sources to identify food outlets and closures. Zenodo supplies public files and a short README. Its API has no standard licence field, but the DataCite record explicitly states Licence Ouverte / Open Licence and links Etalab; access is free. The live processing repository can generate updated data, while this deposit remains a dated snapshot. The review did not inspect CSV contents or verify the precision of outlet coordinates and closure classifications. A reviewer-assessed use is defining food-service locations for access, logistics or disruption simulations. data-openstreetmap supplies complementary street networks; no network join or routing calculation was tested.
